A Ride and a Revelation

Back to quest database

Meet Gigi and Chris at NovaGen, visit Leafy Market, then take Gigi home.

Recorded build reference · 0.8.10.842 · configuration record, not individually play-tested

Work through the objectives

  1. Go to the NovaGen area.
  2. Complete the first conversation with Gigi.
  3. Speak with Chris.
  4. Speak with Gigi again.
  5. Enter Leafy Market.
  6. Buy more seeds. The condition checks a seed-category inventory count greater than two, not a purchase receipt.
  7. Take Gigi back to her ranch area.
  8. Complete the final goodbye conversation.

Checks that can cause a stop

  • The objective order visits Leafy Market before the home drop-off, even though the introductory description mentions them in the opposite order.
  • The success configuration continues to Seed Capital.
Failure conditions, recovery & continuation
Failure trigger
Quest actor death, secondary-quest-actor-death
After failure
Restarts the current quest
After success
Starts configured quest ID F_Quest_13

These route relations come from retained build fields; each branch is not runtime-tested.
